content.text:
Cloudflare documents Clef and Clef-flash as compatible with Jev’s decision API. The repo already supports three transports, but all currently serve Jev. I’ll add a milestone for choosing the decision model independently of the coding worker, while preserving local policy, approvals, and validation.

Entire’s server search was unavailable because of a local keyring timeout; local checkpoints remain readable.

OpenAI’s Decisions API is confirmed too: it’s in public beta with `gpt-6-luna`, and returns predicate probabilities plus choice distributions and confidence. Its response format needs a separate adapter.

The plan will cover Jev, Clef/Clef-flash, and OpenAI Decisions, followed by a shared routing benchmark. I’ll keep TypeSafe as the default until we have evidence to choose another.
